profile.name: HP 3325A 合成函数发生器
profile.description: HP 3325A 是一台 20 MHz 台式合成函数发生器，可输出正弦波、方波、三角波和斜坡波，并支持幅度调制、相位调制以及直流偏置。它常用于电子、电路与仪器实验中的激励信号产生、频率响应测试、校准和通用台架测量。
profile.description_en: The HP 3325A is a 20 MHz bench-top synthesizer/function generator that can produce sine, square, triangle, and ramp waveforms, with support for amplitude modulation, phase modulation, and DC offset. It is commonly used in electronics and instrumentation labs for stimulus generation, frequency-response testing, calibration, and general bench measurements.
